Mr. Senter, S.O.2 telephoned to ask Major Langdon to obtain the letter to Mr. GROEHL, from the Home Office and to forward it to them if we thought fit, together with a copy of the covering letter from Werner ZACHARIAS.

London Region
11.10.41.
